implementation.targetScope: Promise-wrapped IndexedDB databases, transactions, requests, stores, indexes and cursors; read/write shortcuts; async iteration; upgrade/blocked/termination callbacks; native wrap/unwrap and schema-aware declarations. Browser storage for Firebase callers. No polyfill or background transaction keepalive.

source: Written from public API documentation, declaration signatures and black-box controls; no upstream idb runtime read or copied. Two intentional differences: done observes actual complete/abort instead of a preventable request error; wrapping an already settled request resolves its result rather than awaiting an event that already happened.

caller.path: VentiMath frontend -> @firebase/app 0.14.9, @firebase/installations 0.6.20 and @firebase/messaging 0.12.24 -> idb 7.1.1; @aws-amplify/datastore also pins idb 5.0.6
caller.verified: Unchanged Firebase app heartbeat and installation SDKs in Chrome with synthetic IndexedDB records and mocked registration/token responses. Messaging storage shapes are covered by the shared transaction/store API, but a live push registration and Amplify DataStore integration are not claimed. No application dependency change or live data access.
